Whenever your party Sets Up Camp, you may spend @Poke[200] worth of Medical Scrap to set up a Field Clinic. While using the Field Clinic, all members gain the following benefits;
»» You may spend @Poke[300] of Medical Scrap to create and apply a @UUID[Compendium.ptu.items.Item.kTXHG6L2b6NzrWQY]{Bandage} or use a @UUID[Compendium.ptu.items.Item.NJAgpzbxLuwzaRdx]{First Aid Kit}.
»» If you have the @UUID[Compendium.ptu.feats.Item.G3FxaPfnkNH88PiA]{Nurse} Feature, you may spend @Poke[300] to activate it without Draining AP.
»» @UUID[Compendium.ptu.items.Item.2kQmUgVMnwb8JfW4]{Potions}, @UUID[Compendium.ptu.items.Item.SpizuCWOBHGbyOyd]{Super Potions}, @UUID[Compendium.ptu.items.Item.4m1zVnoahZHlSVcd]{Hyper Potions}, @UUID[Compendium.ptu.items.Item.Tb8yKIXVEcWvhmvk]{Full Restores}, @UUID[Compendium.ptu.items.Item.1HkqyxFShtqF6wac]{Revives}, @UUID[Compendium.ptu.items.Item.AbfaIrLufx5RwVvv]{Energy Powders}, and @UUID[Compendium.ptu.items.Item.7rq6umzCl1cTm5ny]{Energy Roots} used in this area heal their target an additional 5 Hit Points.
